info.description: Open positions pulled live from the recruitment system (Traffit). The positions themselves are never entered here — only the copy that surrounds them.

anchor.description: DOM id / URL hash for this section (e.g. "openings" → #openings). Lets nav links target this section on the page.

intro.description: Intro copy shown above the list. The list itself comes from Traffit and cannot be edited here.

emptyState.description: Shown instead of the list when Traffit has no published positions — or when Traffit is temporarily unreachable. Always write something here, otherwise the section renders as an empty gap.

listMode.description: `showMore`: collapse the list behind a toggle once it gets long. `none`: always list every open position.

showMore.description: How many positions stay visible and the toggle's labels. Used when List ending is `showMore`.

button.description: Optional call to action under the list (e.g. a speculative application).
